rows.title: Germinal Commodity details lists its errors by question
rows.detail: On the germinal set's Commodity details page the error summary lists its errors by question, in the order each species block asks them: every quantity error, species by species, then every number of packages error, then every total gross weight error. The temperature is optional, so an unanswered temperature, like a blank number of packages or a blank total gross weight, saves with no error.
acceptanceCriteria: Pressing Save and continue on germinal Commodity details with errors on several species lists every Quantity (unit/pieces) error, species by species, then every Number of packages error, then every Total gross weight error, each linking to its own field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-093; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p4-044; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, -p1-057; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004)

Germinal Commodity details with no temperature chosen, a blank total gross weight, a blank number of packages and a valid quantity for every chosen species saves and moves the trader on, with no error summary on the page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, -p1-023; c-232, c-234, c-462)

The germinal Commodity details error summary lists only Quantity (unit/pieces), Number of packages and Total gross weight messages, however the temperature question is answered. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, -p1-023; c-232, c-462)
rows.notes: The commodities area's half of the existing germinal Commodity details checks row: the error summary ordered by question, and an unanswered temperature, a blank number of packages and a blank total gross weight saving. The germinal-products area drafts the quantity and weight rules on the same page; keep them in one row, since they share one page and one set of checks. Depends on the germinal Commodity details questions row (inc-017), which adds the quantity, number of packages and weight fields. c-232 and c-462 make the germinal total gross weight and temperature optional, so no blank-weight or blank-temperature message is built; c-234 makes the quantity the required count, so quantity errors come first. ruling:sam-2026-11-27 claim 4 keeps the weight per species, so its errors come last in each species block. The live-animals half of the ordering rule (req-114) belongs to the split-off design-snagging theme and is not drafted here.
